description: Round-3's FIND-101 fix (lending-orchestrator.mjs:395, `const borrowerAgentId = freshBorrower.agent_id ?? freshBorrower.agentId;`) corrects a field-CASING bug on the assumption that 'the real, on-disk citizen-registry row stores the borrower's ERC-8004 identity under snake_case agent_id (canonical write site: skills/self/spawn/lib/child-spec.js:65 ... also spawn-orchestrator.mjs's own agent_id: identityResult.agentId write)' (see the fix's own comment, lending-orchestrator.mjs:384-394, and FIND-101.json's evidence). This premise is FALSE, independently re-verified against this repo's own code and its own tests: child-spec.js:65's `spec.agent_id = agentId` and spawn-orchestrator.mjs:680's `agent_id: identityResult.agentId` both write into the CHILDREN LEDGER (spawn-orchestrator.mjs:711, `appendChild(ledgerFile, {...spec, status:'active', ...})`, ledgerFile = self/spawn's own ledger.js store) -- a DIFFERENT file/store than CITIZENS_REGISTRY_PATH, which is the file wake-gate.mjs's buildDefaultGetCitizen actually reads (economy/lending/scripts/wake-gate.mjs:47-71, `readCitizensRegistry(citizensRegistryFile)` then `{...citizen, balanceUsd}` -- zero enrichment from the ledger). The ACTUAL object appended to the citizens registry on a successful spawn is `citizenRecord` (spawn-orchestrator.mjs:713-721: `{id, wallet, walletAddress, fuel, humanDependencies, homeDir, coLocatedWithCoordinator}`) -- it does NOT copy agent_id or agent_evm_address from `spec` at all. This is independently confirmed, without ambiguity, by this same codebase's own test: spawn-orchestrator.test.mjs:494-510 ('REQ-305 call-site: a successful attempt appends a citizens.json record matching REQ-105's exact schema...') which exhaustively enumerates every field of the appended registry record (id/wallet/walletAddress/fuel/humanDependencies/coLocatedWithCoordinator/telemetryPath(undefined)/status(undefined)) and asserts NOTHING about agent_id -- while the SIBLING test at spawn-orchestrator.test.mjs:525-539 confirms agent_id/agent_evm_address instead land on `readLedgerRows(...)[0]` (the LEDGER, not the registry). The genesis/seed citizens registry (skills/self/spawn/registry/citizens.seed.json, read via ensureCitizensRegistry/bootstrapCitizensRegistry at wake-gate.mjs:110) is consulted independently and ALSO contains zero agent_id field on its one seeded row ('Franklin'). A repo-wide grep for `agent_id` under skills/ returns exactly 9 files -- lending-orchestrator.mjs (this fix), its own test, reputation-gate.mjs (parameter name only), a Bash test string, spawn-orchestrator.mjs, child-spec.js, and 3 spawn-orchestrator test files -- none of which enrich the citizens-registry read path with agent_id anywhere. CONSEQUENCE: `freshBorrower.agent_id` (and `.agentId`) are STILL, in production, ALWAYS undefined for every real citizen -- spawned or genesis -- exactly as they were before round 3's fix, just for a different reason. The 3 new round-3 tests (lending-orchestrator.test.mjs:274-349) do NOT catch this: they manually inject `agent_id: '42'` into a hand-built `baseCitizen()` fixture object that this feature's own test file invents (line 80-91) -- a shape that has now been proven, by this repo's own spawn-orchestrator tests and its own seed file, to never occur on a real citizens-registry row. G3's own design-spec done-criterion (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-12-franklin-reputation-gasless-design.md:13, '閾値設定時に実績不足 borrower が弾かれる') requires a configured gate to distinguish sufficient from insufficient borrowers -- but because borrowerAgentId is genuinely always undefined in production, reputation-gate.mjs's own intentional fail-closed branch ('no_borrower_agent_id', reputation-gate.mjs:32) still rejects EVERY borrower unconditionally the instant any lender configures a threshold, sufficient or not -- the EXACT functional defect FIND-101 (round 2) reported, now proven to survive round 3's fix intact, under a root cause the fix's own evidence chain misattributed.
